key_insight: ParetoChat translates natural-language preferences into optimization parameters, helping users explore trade-offs without specifying numerical weights directly.
engineering_relevance: The interface can help business stakeholders navigate competing objectives while an optimization system computes candidate solutions.
method: Separate agents handle input processing, multi-criteria expertise, solution presentation, and feedback.
Convert user requests into structured scalarization parameters and invoke an optimization system.
Present candidate solutions and iteratively refine the search using user feedback.
evidence_signal: Experiments used an LLM-simulated decision maker on binary knapsack and set-partitioning instances, benchmarked against DESDEO reference-point and NIMBUS methods, with an additional historical courier-order assignment application.
watch_item: Evaluation with an LLM-simulated decision maker leaves real-user preference fidelity and usability to be validated.
paper_title: ParetoChat: An LLM-Based Interface for Interactive Multi-Objective Optimization
